title: When familiarity wears away respect
meaning_odia: ଅତି ପରିଚୟରେ ଲୋକେ ପରସ୍ପରକୁ ହେୟ ମନେ କରିବା ବା ଯଥୋଚିତ ସମ୍ମାନ ଦେବା ଭୁଲିଯିବାର ଆଶଙ୍କା ରହେ—କଥାଟି ସେହି ବିଷୟରେ ସତର୍କ କରେ।
explanation: Knowing someone very well can turn into taking that person for granted. The saying warns about the point where ease becomes disregard. The inspected Odia Vasa gloss likewise connects excessive familiarity with loss of respect.
usage_example: Friends begin interrupting and dismissing one another because they assume no courtesy is needed between them. One might recall this saying to ask for more consideration. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The compact line makes its warning through the contrast between ପରିଚୟ, familiarity, and ଗୌରବ, dignity or regard. This edition reads it as a reminder to preserve respect within closeness; no particular social rank or household practice is specified.

odia_summary: ଘନିଷ୍ଠତା ବଢ଼ିଲେ ବି ପରସ୍ପରର ସମ୍ମାନ ରହୁ।
english_summary: Closeness can erode respect when people begin taking one another for granted.
